items.title: Technip Energies awarded engineering and technology contracts by Petkim for the development of a proposed integrated petrochemical complex in Türkiye
items.summary: Technip Energies awarded contrats by Petkim Petrochemical complex in Aliağa, Türkiye. Technip Energies (PARIS:TE) has been awarded contracts by Petkim, a subsidiary of SOCAR, in connection with the development of a proposed integrated petrochemical complex in Aliağa, Türkiye.
